findings.title: Supply is concentrated
findings.detail: The top 10 owners control 61.0% of supply once linked wallets are merged (it looks like 58.7% if you count wallets naively).

findings.title: 8 hidden wallet clusters
findings.detail: 25 top-holder wallets resolve to 8 linked groups holding 56.6% of supply. The largest (3 wallets) holds 52.9%.

findings.title: Linked wallets are selling
findings.detail: Clustered wallets moved out 1.5% of supply in the last 7 days.

findings.title: Fresh wallets are driving demand
findings.detail: Brand-new wallets net bought $40,080,091 this week, far outpacing proven traders.

findings.title: Smart Money is holding
findings.detail: 24 Smart Money wallets hold 3.0% of supply.
